text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Japanese Derby. In the 
underground walkway, Rice Shower and 
Mihono Bourbon share a passionate 
handshake――

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once again watching the scene from hiding 
was Matikanetannhauser. To the question, 
"Why are you always hiding?"—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once again watching the scene from hiding 
was Matikanetannhauser. To the question, 
"Why are you always hiding?"—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She answered as if it were obvious, saying 
it would be strange for an ordinary 
Umamusume to get mixed in among them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Or rather, why does Chairwoman Akikawa 
expect so much from an ordinary girl like 
me...?" With that faint question lingering 
in her mind—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The battle to determine the number one of 
the generation, the Japanese Derby, raises 
its curtains...!
